title: CallReceipt
description: A signed, tamper-evident record of one successful glyph call.

inputHash.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the call input.

outputHash.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the call output.

serverPublicKey.description: Hex ed25519 public key the receipt signature verifies against.

signature.description: Hex ed25519 signature over the canonical hash of the receipt (all fields except signature).
